config.label: Optional AirNow API key for real-time and forecast air quality data
config.description: Optional AirNow API key for real-time and forecast air quality data. When unset, the epa_airnow_get_conditions tool is not registered and the other tools run without it. Free registration at docs.airnowapi.org.

config.label: Optional override for the EJScreen (EJAM) API base URL used by epa_ejscreen_get_scores
config.description: Optional override for the EJScreen (EJAM) API base URL used by epa_ejscreen_get_scores. Defaults to https://api.ejanalysis.com — the community-maintained EJScreen rehost by Public Environmental Data Partners.
